name: Intercept Line
summary: Intercept Line is a strategy and simulation game in which you command Ukraine's air defense on a real map of Ukraine. Every night swarms of Shahed drones, cruise missiles, ballistic and hypersonic missiles strike your cities and infrastructure, and there are never enough interceptors: deploy SAM batteries, anti-aircraft guns, mobile fire teams, radars and fighter jets, and decide what to protect. By day it is your turn: plan long-range drone and missile strikes on enemy refineries, airbases and depots, routing around enemy radars and air defenses or suppressing them to open a corridor for the next wave. When orders are not enough, take the controls of a fighter jet yourself. Online co-op for up to 4 players.
